svg.title: Find and check the recipient's receiving destination
svg.desc: Proposed logical design. No central AEAT directory is assumed. All outcomes retain source, scope, time and policy. Early lookup is advisory. Failed or partial negative lookup cannot select the public route. New evidence never rewrites a sent plan. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.
